d.ko: The threequel to the party game phenomenon features the deadly quiz show Trivia Murder Party, the say-anything sequel Quiplash 2, the surprising survey game Guesspionage, the t-shirt slugfest Tee K.O., and the sneaky trickster game Fakin’ It. Use your phones or tablets as controllers, and play with up to 8 players, plus an audience of up to 10,000!

Guesspionage sucks! It kept receiving an input of 3%, but we were submitting much higher values on our phones. None of the phone pie charts were matching the TV pie chart. Totally unplayable!
非常著名的多人派对游戏，游戏程序本身更像一个服务器，实际需要手机/平板登录指定网站输入房间号才能多人一起游戏 但不推荐真的入手去玩（无关游戏质量），本身游戏只有英文，而且基本上都需要本地多人才能游戏，只是联网游戏的话基本是体会不到乐趣的
